plain: A working chart of the capability nodes a robotic or unmanned military system depends on, from sensors to production tooling. Each node lists the firms the scorecard package evidences against it. A node with no evidence is shown as empty, not filled by inference.

tiers.label: Sensing
tiers.plain: Detectors, seekers, optics and radar front ends that let a platform see.

tiers.label: Navigation and guidance
tiers.plain: Inertial units, timing, satellite navigation and flight control that let a platform know where it is.

tiers.label: Actuation, motion and power
tiers.plain: Servos, motors, drives, transmissions, batteries and converters that let a platform move.

tiers.label: Compute and RF microsystems
tiers.plain: Rugged processors, GPUs, data converters and RF components that run onboard processing.

tiers.label: Communications and datalinks
tiers.plain: Tactical links, mesh networks, anti-jam radios and unattended-system communications.

tiers.label: Autonomy and platform integration
tiers.plain: Unmanned platforms, swarming, mission integration, legged robots and autonomy software.

tiers.label: Counter-UAS
tiers.plain: Detection, electronic warfare and control layers against drones; a crowded integrator market.

tiers.label: Production robotics and tooling
tiers.plain: Industrial robots, CNC controls and shipyard automation that build the systems.

tiers.label: Test, validation and screening
tiers.plain: Electromagnetic simulation, calibration, reliability and acceptance testing.

nodes.label: Infrared and electro-optical sensors
nodes.plain: Thermal cores, cooled and uncooled detectors, lasers, optics and star trackers.

nodes.label: Radar seekers and active-array front ends
nodes.plain: Seeker transmitters, AESA transmit-receive modules and the GaN/GaAs chips inside them.

nodes.label: MEMS sensors and inertial chips
nodes.plain: Sensor chips, MEMS inertial units, lidar drivers and the foundry platforms behind them.

nodes.label: Inertial navigation and guidance
nodes.plain: Inertial navigation units, accelerometers, inertial servos and guidance sets.

nodes.label: Flight control and avionics
nodes.plain: Flight-control computers, avionics and integrated INS for unmanned aircraft.

nodes.label: Timing and satellite navigation
nodes.plain: Atomic clocks, timing references and BeiDou receivers.

nodes.label: Servos, motors and transmissions
nodes.plain: Servo control, precision transmission, micro motors, motor drives and interconnects.

nodes.label: Robot motion and payload modules
nodes.plain: Motion units and electro-optical modules built for military robots.

nodes.label: Batteries and power conversion
nodes.plain: Special batteries, battery management and aircraft power converters.

nodes.label: Manipulators and end effectors
nodes.plain: Arms, grippers and tool interfaces for ground and shipboard robots.

nodes.label: Rugged embedded compute and signal processing
nodes.plain: High-reliability GPUs, radar signal processors and rugged flight or counter-UAS computers.

nodes.label: RF microsystems and passives
nodes.plain: Data converters, RF power, microsystems, ferrites and circulators.

nodes.label: Edge AI accelerators
nodes.plain: Domestic chips for onboard perception and autonomy inference.

nodes.label: Tactical datalinks and BeiDou terminals
nodes.plain: Navigation datalinks, EW terminals and BeiDou-integrated links.

nodes.label: Military networks and UAV communications nodes
nodes.plain: Command networks, UAV communication nodes and unattended-system radios.

nodes.label: Swarm mesh and mission computing
nodes.plain: Mesh networking and mission computers for drone swarms.

nodes.label: Unmanned platforms and swarming integration
nodes.plain: Integrators of unmanned platforms, swarming and mission systems.

nodes.label: Robotics and autonomy integration
nodes.plain: Firms integrating autonomy stacks into ground and special robots.

nodes.label: Legged and special robots
nodes.plain: Quadrupeds and special-purpose robots, including the robot-dog tender lane.

nodes.label: Autonomy software and perception models
nodes.plain: Perception, planning and control software, model interfaces and simulation for autonomy.

nodes.label: Humanoid platforms
nodes.plain: General-purpose humanoid robots with a documented defense or dual-use customer.

nodes.label: Counter-UAS detection, EW and control
nodes.plain: Detection, jamming, and command layers against drones.

nodes.label: Shipyard production robotics
nodes.plain: Robotic grinding, welding and shipyard automation.

nodes.label: CNC controls and machine-tool components
nodes.plain: Controllers, servo drives and machine-tool components.

nodes.label: Industrial robot arms for defense lines
nodes.plain: Six-axis and collaborative arms with a documented defense-plant deployment.

nodes.label: Electromagnetic simulation and array calibration
nodes.plain: Simulation, calibration and validation of active arrays.

nodes.label: Reliability, EMC and acceptance testing
nodes.plain: Environmental, EMC, screening and software acceptance testing.

nodes.label: Simulation and digital twins for autonomy
nodes.plain: Synthetic training data, digital twins and hardware-in-the-loop for autonomy.
